name: Curved combiners
note: Do not scale, bend, or use enclosure screws to preload optical surfaces. Exact revision and poses require comparison with the physical build.

name: BOE VS035ZSM-NW0-69P0 panels + adapters
note: Panel identity inferred from adapter marking. Preserve panel angle, active-area location, ribbon orientation and optical calibration.

name: Northstar USB-C display controller
note: DP Alt Mode video input. Keep high-speed panel FPCs short. A USB-C connector alone does not establish voltage or PD behavior.

name: Xvisio XR50 tracking module
note: Published XR50 revisions differ. Measure this housing and adapter; do not substitute SlimEdge dimensions. Moving it requires updating tracker-to-eye extrinsics.

name: Ultraleap SIR170
evidence: Ultraleap evaluation-kit datasheet, bare module only
note: 10 g excludes adapter, backing and cable. Supply specification is 5 V with at least 0.5 A capacity, not a measured 2.5 W operating load. ARM runtime remains unverified.

name: Northstar Next USB 2 high-speed hub
location: Brow or temple root if cable reach permits
note: Revision and connector pinout must match. Independent supply is not equivalent to adding VBUS onto an existing host power rail.

name: Northstar Next RP2040 controller
location: Temple root if existing FFC permits
note: Retain existing control/brightness firmware and connector mapping before relocating.

name: Wearable computer
evidence: Windows stack is working in this repository
note: Baseline: x86-64 Windows with suitable DP output. Pi 5 and Jetson are experiments pending SIR170, XR50, display-mode and compositor validation.

name: USB-PD battery + power distribution
note: Use protected off-the-shelf pack and rated converters. Specify simultaneous output PDOs, total/port limits and renegotiation behavior. Do not select from advertised watts alone.

name: Printed carrier, covers and temples
evidence: Design requirement; not yet validated geometry
note: Separate rigid optical datum structure from removable covers and temple loads. Metal hinges with replaceable screws and reinforced mounts.
